scope: Every new validation artifact and all five changed source/test files; generated dependency/build/runtime/database files excluded.
sanitizationApplied: Runtime wrapper suppresses credential values and replaces workspace/home paths before writing logs.
Account/runtime/private session records excluded; cleanup proof contains only aggregate counts and hashes.
Log trailing whitespace and surplus EOF blank lines normalized; all non-whitespace content retained.
limitations: Pattern/literal scan is not a universal secret detector. No binary screenshots are part of this repair evidence.
